blocks.zh: 驗證規劃 & 供應商評估
blocks.en: Validation Planning & Supplier Assessment

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Distinguish between a Validation Policy, Validation Master Plan (VMP), and a computerized system Validation Plan — and know when each is required. 區分驗證政策、驗證主計畫 (VMP) 與系統驗證計畫的層次，並知道何時需要各層文件。
blocks.en: Distinguish between a Validation Policy, Validation Master Plan (VMP), and a computerized system Validation Plan — and know when each is required.

blocks.zh: Define the mandatory content elements of a computerized system validation plan, including scope, risk management, validation strategy, deliverables, and acceptance criteria. 掌握系統驗證計畫的必備要素：範疇、風險管理、驗證策略、交付件與接受標準。
blocks.en: Define the mandatory content elements of a computerized system validation plan, including scope, risk management, validation strategy, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: Explain how to correctly scope a CSV validation project — which systems to include and what depth of testing is proportionate to risk. 能正確界定 CSV 驗證專案的範圍，判斷哪些系統須納入、測試深度如何與風險成比例。
blocks.en: Explain how to correctly scope a CSV validation project — which systems to include and what depth of testing is proportionate to risk.

blocks.zh: Describe the three types of supplier assessment (basic, postal/email audit, on-site/virtual audit) and select the appropriate method based on system impact and supplier risk. 描述三種供應商評估類型，並根據系統影響與供應商風險選擇適當方式。
blocks.en: Describe the three types of supplier assessment (basic, postal/email audit, on-site/virtual audit) and select the appropriate method based on system impact and supplier risk.

blocks.zh: Apply the M2 supplier assessment process — from initial risk decision through audit, corrective actions, acceptance, and periodic re-evaluation. 執行 M2 供應商評估流程：初始風險決策 → 稽核 → 矯正行動 → 接受 → 定期再評估。
blocks.en: Apply the M2 supplier assessment process — from initial risk decision through audit, corrective actions, acceptance, and periodic re-evaluation.

blocks.zh: Identify red flags in supplier assessment results that indicate more in-house regulated company testing is required. 識別供應商評估中的紅旗警訊，判斷何時需要強化自有測試以彌補供應商不足。
blocks.en: Identify red flags in supplier assessment results that indicate more in-house regulated company testing is required.

blocks.zh: Appendix M1 — Validation Planning: Introduction & Scope Appendix M1 — 驗證計畫：簡介與範圍
blocks.en: Appendix M1 — Validation Planning: Introduction & Scope

blocks.zh: 中文解說：文件層次結構
blocks.en: Commentary: Document Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 三層文件架構
blocks.en: Three-Tier Document Structure

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 把 CSV 的規劃文件分成三個層次，很多人混用，但邏輯其實很清楚：
blocks.en: GAMP 5 divides CSV planning documents into three tiers. Many people mix them up, but the logic is actually quite clear:

blocks.zh: 驗證政策 (Validation Policy)：公司層級，定義整體方針與管理承諾。通常是一份 SOP 或 Corporate Procedure，說明「我們公司如何處理 CSV」。
blocks.en: Validation Policy: company level; defines the overall approach and management commitment. It is usually an SOP or corporate procedure explaining "how our company handles CSV".

blocks.zh: 驗證主計畫 VMP：Site 或大型專案層級，列出範圍內所有設施/系統/流程及其驗證狀態、排程、變更控制方式。是稽查員常看的文件。
blocks.en: Validation Master Plan (VMP): site or large-project level; lists all facilities, systems and processes in scope together with their validation status, schedule and change control approach. Inspectors often look at this document.

blocks.zh: 系統驗證計畫 (CSV Plan / SVP)：單一系統層級，詳細描述如何驗證這個特定系統。這是 M1 的核心主題。
blocks.en: System Validation Plan (CSV Plan / SVP): single-system level; describes in detail how this specific system will be validated. This is the core topic of M1.

blocks.zh: 比喻：工廠建設
blocks.en: Analogy: Building a Factory

blocks.zh: 把這三個文件想成蓋工廠：
blocks.en: Think of the three documents as building a factory:

blocks.zh: 驗證政策 = 公司的「建設規範手冊」
blocks.en: Validation Policy = the company's "construction standards manual"

blocks.zh: VMP = 整個廠區的建設總計畫書
blocks.en: VMP = the master plan for the whole site

blocks.zh: 系統驗證計畫 = 某棟建築物的施工圖
blocks.en: System Validation Plan = the construction drawings for one particular building

blocks.zh: 沒有每棟都有施工圖，整個廠就蓋不起來。沒有總計畫，施工圖之間就沒有協調。
blocks.en: Without drawings for each building, the plant cannot be built. Without a master plan, there is no coordination between the drawings.

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 第二版的重要轉向
blocks.en: An Important Shift in GAMP 5 Second Edition

blocks.zh: 第二版明確「去強調 VMP」——這是個值得注意的訊號。監管機關越來越在意你每個系統有沒有做好，而不是有沒有一份漂亮的 VMP 文件。
blocks.en: The second edition explicitly de-emphasizes the VMP, which is a signal worth noting. Regulators increasingly care whether each system has been done properly, not whether you have a polished VMP document.

blocks.zh: SaaS 和 Agile 的納入也很重要：LIMS 越來越多走 SaaS，MES 廠商開始用 Agile 開發，傳統的 V-model 驗證計畫需要調整。
blocks.en: The inclusion of SaaS and Agile is also important: LIMS increasingly run as SaaS and MES vendors are adopting Agile development, so the traditional V-model validation plan needs to be adapted.

blocks.zh: 範圍判斷：什麼系統要獨立做 CSV？
blocks.en: Scoping: Which Systems Need Their Own CSV?

blocks.zh: GAMP 明確說：如果電腦系統是「製程設備的一部分」（例如填充機的 PLC），就應該整合在設備確效 (Equipment Qualification) 裡，不要單獨做 CSV。
blocks.en: GAMP states clearly that if a computerized system is "part of process equipment" (for example, the PLC of a filling machine), it should be integrated into equipment qualification, and should not be given a separate CSV.

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見錯誤：對每台高壓滅菌器的控制器各做一份 CSV 計畫，造成文件爆炸但沒有實質效益。正確做法是在設備 IQ/OQ 裡涵蓋 PLC 的軟體確認。
blocks.en: A common CDMO mistake: writing a separate CSV plan for the controller of every autoclave, which creates an explosion of documents with no real benefit. The correct approach is to cover verification of the PLC software within the equipment IQ/OQ.

blocks.zh: 9.3 Computerized System Validation Plans — Content Requirements 9.3 電腦化系統驗證計畫 — 內容要求
blocks.en: 9.3 Computerized System Validation Plans — Content Requirements

blocks.zh: 中文解說：驗證計畫的本質
blocks.en: Commentary: The Nature of a Validation Plan

blocks.zh: 驗證計畫 = 策略文件，不是測試腳本
blocks.en: A Validation Plan Is a Strategy Document, Not a Test Script

blocks.zh: 很多人把驗證計畫寫成測試腳本的目錄，這是誤解。驗證計畫的核心功能是回答：
blocks.en: Many people write the validation plan as an index of test scripts, which is a misunderstanding. The core function of a validation plan is to answer:

blocks.zh: 這個系統的 GxP 風險在哪？
blocks.en: Where does this system's GxP risk lie?

blocks.zh: 我們打算用什麼策略確認它合規且適合使用？
blocks.en: What strategy will we use to confirm it is compliant and fit for intended use?

blocks.zh: 整個生命週期誰負責什麼？
blocks.en: Who is responsible for what across the whole lifecycle?

blocks.zh: 測試腳本是執行層的文件，會在後面的 OQ/PQ Protocol 裡。
blocks.en: Test scripts are execution-level documents and belong later in the OQ/PQ protocols.

blocks.zh: 稽查員的視角
blocks.en: The Inspector's Perspective

blocks.zh: GAMP 明確說：驗證計畫是稽查中「第一個被拿出來看」的文件。稽查員用它來了解你的整體策略，再決定要深挖哪裡。
blocks.en: GAMP states clearly that the validation plan is the first document pulled out during an inspection. Inspectors use it to understand your overall strategy and then decide where to dig deeper.

blocks.zh: 所以寫驗證計畫時要想：「這份文件能讓一個不熟悉這個系統的 FDA 稽查員，在 15 分鐘內理解我們的合規策略嗎？」
blocks.en: So when writing a validation plan, ask yourself: "Could this document let an FDA inspector who is unfamiliar with this system understand our compliance strategy within 15 minutes?"

blocks.zh: SaaS 系統的特殊處理
blocks.en: Special Handling for SaaS Systems

blocks.zh: 用 SaaS LIMS（如 LabVantage Cloud、Veeva Vault）時，供應商負責大部分基礎架構和應用程式的驗證。你的驗證計畫需要說明：
blocks.en: When using a SaaS LIMS (such as LabVantage Cloud or Veeva Vault), the supplier is responsible for validating most of the infrastructure and application. Your validation plan needs to explain:

blocks.zh: 你如何「借用」供應商的驗證文件（SOC 2 報告、IQ/OQ 文件）
blocks.en: How you will "leverage" the supplier's validation documents (SOC 2 report, IQ/OQ documents)

blocks.zh: 你自己要做哪些 Configuration Qualification 和 UAT
blocks.en: Which Configuration Qualification and UAT activities you will perform yourself

blocks.zh: 供應商更新版本時你的維護策略
blocks.en: Your maintenance strategy when the supplier releases new versions

blocks.zh: 監管責任永遠在你這邊，不能推給供應商。
blocks.en: Regulatory responsibility always remains with you and cannot be passed to the supplier.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：誰核准驗證計畫？
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Who Approves the Validation Plan?

blocks.zh: GAMP 說：流程負責人 (Process Owner) + 品質單位 (QU)。
blocks.en: GAMP says: the Process Owner plus the Quality Unit (QU).

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 實際操作中，通常是：
blocks.en: In actual CDMO operations, this is usually:

blocks.zh: LIMS → QC 主管 (Process Owner) + QA
blocks.en: LIMS → QC manager (Process Owner) + QA

blocks.zh: MES → 製造主管 + QA
blocks.en: MES → Manufacturing manager + QA

blocks.zh: ERP → IT/Finance 主管 + QA（GxP 範圍內的模組）
blocks.en: ERP → IT/Finance manager + QA (for GxP-relevant modules)

blocks.zh: IT 部門通常不是 Process Owner，他們是技術支援者。這個角色釐清非常重要，否則驗證計畫永遠找不到人負責。
blocks.en: The IT department is usually not the Process Owner; it acts as technical support. Clarifying this role is very important, otherwise the validation plan will never find anyone to take ownership.

blocks.zh: 9.3.3 Contents of the Computerized System Validation Plan 9.3.3 電腦化系統驗證計畫的內容
blocks.en: 9.3.3 Contents of the Computerized System Validation Plan

blocks.zh: 中文解說：驗證計畫各要素的實務意義
blocks.en: Commentary: Practical Meaning of the Validation Plan Elements

blocks.zh: CDMO 多系統管理的挑戰
blocks.en: The Challenge of Managing Multiple Systems in a CDMO

blocks.zh: 典型的無菌製造 CDMO 需要管理的 GxP 電腦系統包括：
blocks.en: The GxP computerized systems a typical sterile manufacturing CDMO must manage include:

blocks.zh: LIMS（實驗室資訊管理系統）
blocks.en: LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System)

blocks.zh: MES（製造執行系統）
blocks.en: MES (Manufacturing Execution System)

blocks.zh: BMS（建築管理系統 — 潔淨室壓差/溫溼度）
blocks.en: BMS (Building Management System — cleanroom differential pressure, temperature and humidity)

blocks.zh: 高壓滅菌器控制器
blocks.en: Autoclave controllers

blocks.zh: 填充機 PLC
blocks.en: Filling machine PLC

blocks.zh: ERP（庫存/批次記錄相關模組）
blocks.en: ERP (modules related to inventory and batch records)

blocks.zh: 凍乾機控制系統
blocks.en: Lyophilizer control system

blocks.zh: 每個系統都需要一份驗證計畫，但「深度」不同：LIMS 和 MES 影響最大，需要完整的 CSV 文件；填充機 PLC 可以整合在設備確效中。
blocks.en: Every system needs a validation plan, but the depth differs: LIMS and MES have the greatest impact and need full CSV documentation; the filling machine PLC can be integrated into equipment qualification.

blocks.zh: ERP 的 GxP 範圍判斷
blocks.en: Determining GxP Scope in ERP

blocks.zh: ERP（如 SAP、Oracle）是很好的例子：系統很大，但不是所有模組都是 GxP。
blocks.en: ERP (such as SAP or Oracle) is a good example: the system is large, but not every module is GxP.

blocks.zh: 通常需要 CSV 的模組：
blocks.en: Modules that usually need CSV:

blocks.zh: 批次記錄管理 / 電子批次記錄
blocks.en: Batch record management / electronic batch records

blocks.zh: 原料庫存與放行狀態管理
blocks.en: Raw material inventory and release status management

blocks.zh: 有效期限控制
blocks.en: Expiry date control

blocks.zh: 通常不需要 CSV 的模組：採購、財務、HR。
blocks.en: Modules that usually do not need CSV: procurement, finance, HR.

blocks.zh: 驗證計畫必須清楚說明這個判斷的依據，而不只是說「ERP 的 GxP 功能」。
blocks.en: The validation plan must clearly state the rationale for this decision, rather than simply saying "the GxP functions of the ERP".

blocks.zh: CDMO 驗證計畫模板建議內容
blocks.en: Recommended Contents of a CDMO Validation Plan Template

blocks.zh: 系統 GxP 影響評估（高/中/低）及判斷依據
blocks.en: System GxP impact assessment (high/medium/low) and the rationale

blocks.zh: 系統邊界圖（與哪些系統介接？資料流向？）
blocks.en: System boundary diagram (which systems does it interface with? what are the data flows?)

blocks.zh: RASCI 矩陣（Responsible/Accountable/Supporting/Consulted/Informed）
blocks.en: RASCI matrix (Responsible/Accountable/Supporting/Consulted/Informed)

blocks.zh: 供應商評估結果摘要（引用 SA Report）
blocks.en: Summary of supplier assessment results (referencing the SA Report)

blocks.zh: 要借用哪些供應商文件（IQ/OQ Doc、Dev Testing Records）
blocks.en: Which supplier documents will be leveraged (IQ/OQ documents, development testing records)

blocks.zh: 自有驗證活動清單（Config Spec、UAT、Performance Qual）
blocks.en: List of in-house validation activities (configuration specification, UAT, performance qualification)

blocks.zh: 系統上線後的持續合規計畫（Annual Review、Change Control）
blocks.en: Ongoing compliance plan after go-live (annual review, change control)

blocks.zh: 9.4–9.5 Validation Policies & Validation Master Plans 9.4–9.5 驗證政策與驗證主計畫
blocks.en: 9.4–9.5 Validation Policies & Validation Master Plans

blocks.zh: 中文解說：VMP vs 系統驗證計畫
blocks.en: Commentary: VMP vs System Validation Plan

blocks.zh: VMP 的定位與實務價值
blocks.en: Positioning and Practical Value of the VMP

blocks.zh: VMP 最大的用途其實是「對外展示合規全貌」——稽查員可以從一份文件了解整個廠的驗證範圍與現況。
blocks.en: The greatest use of a VMP is actually to present the full picture of compliance externally: an inspector can understand the validation scope and status of the entire site from a single document.

blocks.zh: 對內，VMP 的實際功能是：
blocks.en: Internally, the practical functions of the VMP are to:

blocks.zh: 讓管理層知道驗證資源需求（錢、人、時間）
blocks.en: Let management see the validation resource needs (money, people, time)

blocks.zh: 提供一個所有系統驗證狀態的「儀表板」
blocks.en: Provide a "dashboard" of the validation status of all systems

blocks.zh: 確保不同部門的驗證活動有一致的標準
blocks.en: Ensure consistent standards across validation activities in different departments

blocks.zh: VMP 常見的兩個錯誤
blocks.en: Two Common VMP Mistakes

blocks.zh:
錯誤一：VMP 寫得太詳細
VMP 是摘要文件，不是驗證指引。如果你的 VMP 超過 50 頁，可能是把系統驗證計畫的內容塞進去了。
blocks.en:
Mistake 1: The VMP is too detailed
The VMP is a summary document, not a validation guideline. If your VMP exceeds 50 pages, you have probably packed the content of the system validation plans into it.

blocks.zh:
錯誤二：VMP 與實際狀況脫節
VMP 列了 20 個系統要做 CSV，但 10 個還沒做。這種情況在稽查中是紅旗。VMP 應該如實反映現況並說明計畫。
blocks.en:
Mistake 2: The VMP is out of step with reality
The VMP lists 20 systems requiring CSV, but 10 have not been done. In an inspection this is a red flag. The VMP should reflect the current situation honestly and explain the plan.

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 第二版的信號：VMP 降級了
blocks.en: Signal from GAMP 5 Second Edition: The VMP Is Downgraded

blocks.zh: 第二版明確「de-emphasize VMP」，這反映監管實踐的轉變：
blocks.en: The second edition explicitly "de-emphasizes the VMP", which reflects a shift in regulatory practice:

blocks.zh: FDA 和 EMA 稽查員越來越傾向直接看系統層級的驗證文件，而不是從 VMP 開始。他們想看的是：「這個特定系統，你們的 URS → IQ/OQ/PQ → 年度審查是否完整？」
blocks.en: FDA and EMA inspectors increasingly prefer to go directly to system-level validation documents rather than start from the VMP. What they want to see is: "For this specific system, is your URS → IQ/OQ/PQ → annual review chain complete?"

blocks.zh: 如果 VMP 沒有更新（很多公司 VMP 兩三年沒動），反而會在稽查中造成負面印象。
blocks.en: If the VMP is not kept up to date (many companies have not touched theirs for two or three years), it actually creates a negative impression during an inspection.

blocks.zh: CDMO 建議：VMP 精簡化策略
blocks.en: CDMO Recommendation: A Streamlined VMP Strategy

blocks.zh: 針對中小型 CDMO，建議採用「一層 VMP + 系統索引」的策略：
blocks.en: For small and mid-sized CDMOs, we recommend a "one-tier VMP plus system index" strategy:

blocks.zh: 一份 Site VMP（約 10-15 頁）：說明驗證政策、範圍、組織、變更控制原則
blocks.en: One site VMP (about 10-15 pages): describes the validation policy, scope, organization and change control principles

blocks.zh: CSV 系統清冊 (Inventory)（附件格式）：列出所有 GxP 系統、驗證狀態、下次審查日期
blocks.en: CSV system inventory (as an appendix): lists all GxP systems, their validation status and next review date

blocks.zh: 每個系統的驗證計畫（各自維護）
blocks.en: A validation plan for each system (maintained separately)

blocks.zh: 每年更新 CSV 系統清冊，VMP 本身只在重大政策改變時修訂。這比維護一份龐大的 VMP 更現實且更有效。
blocks.en: Update the CSV system inventory every year; revise the VMP itself only when there is a major policy change. This is more realistic and more effective than maintaining a huge VMP.

blocks.zh: Appendix M2 — Supplier Assessment: Introduction & Rationale Appendix M2 — 供應商評估：簡介與理由
blocks.en: Appendix M2 — Supplier Assessment: Introduction & Rationale

blocks.zh: 中文解說：為什麼要做供應商評估？
blocks.en: Commentary: Why Assess Suppliers?

blocks.zh: 核心邏輯：你無法在交貨後補救品質
blocks.en: Core Logic: You Cannot Fix Quality After Delivery

blocks.zh: GAMP 最關鍵的一句話："The supplier should build quality and integrity into a software product during development, as it cannot be added effectively later by the regulated company."
blocks.en: The most critical sentence in GAMP: "The supplier should build quality and integrity into a software product during development, as it cannot be added effectively later by the regulated company."

blocks.zh: 這就是供應商評估存在的根本原因——你必須在合作前確認供應商的開發流程是可靠的，因為你無法在收到軟體後「加回品質」。
blocks.en: This is the fundamental reason supplier assessment exists: before engaging a supplier you must confirm that their development process is reliable, because you cannot "add quality back" once you have received the software.

blocks.zh: 比喻：採購藥用原料
blocks.en: Analogy: Purchasing a Pharmaceutical Raw Material

blocks.zh: 就像你採購一個原料 API：你可以做一些品管測試，但如果供應商的製造流程本身就有問題，光靠你的抽樣測試是抓不出所有問題的。
blocks.en: It is like buying an API raw material: you can run some quality control tests, but if the supplier's manufacturing process itself has problems, your sampling tests alone cannot catch every issue.

blocks.zh: 所以你要做供應商審查 (Vendor Qualification)，確保他們的工廠和流程符合 GMP。CSV 供應商評估的邏輯完全一樣。
blocks.en: That is why you perform vendor qualification, to ensure their facility and processes comply with GMP. The logic of CSV supplier assessment is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 第二版新增的三個考量
blocks.en: Three New Considerations in GAMP 5 Second Edition

blocks.zh: XaaS/Cloud 供應商：SaaS 供應商可能不接受傳統的 postal audit，需要依賴認證（SOC 2+、ISO 27001）。
blocks.en: XaaS/Cloud suppliers: SaaS suppliers may not accept a traditional postal audit, so you need to rely on certifications (SOC 2+, ISO 27001).

blocks.zh: Agile 開發工具：供應商用 Jira、Azure DevOps 管理需求和測試記錄，這些工具中的 artifacts 都可以作為評估證據，不只是傳統的紙本文件。
blocks.en: Agile development tools: suppliers use Jira or Azure DevOps to manage requirements and test records, and the artifacts in these tools can serve as assessment evidence, not just traditional paper documents.

blocks.zh: 數據完整性：評估時必須涵蓋供應商如何確保數據完整性，包括稽核軌跡、存取控制等。
blocks.en: Data integrity: the assessment must cover how the supplier ensures data integrity, including audit trails and access control.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：「借用供應商文件」的合規策略
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: A Compliance Strategy for "Leveraging Supplier Documents"

blocks.zh: 供應商評估的最大實際效益是：讓你可以減少自己的驗證測試量。
blocks.en: The greatest practical benefit of supplier assessment is that it lets you reduce your own validation testing.

blocks.zh: 如果供應商的 SDQ (Software Development Qualification) 文件品質很好、IQ/OQ 測試非常完整，你可以用這些文件加上 site-specific 的 UAT 來完成驗證，而不需要從頭做所有的功能測試。
blocks.en: If the supplier's SDQ (Software Development Qualification) documents are of good quality and their IQ/OQ testing is very thorough, you can complete validation using these documents plus site-specific UAT, rather than performing all functional testing from scratch.

blocks.zh: 但這個「減量」必須基於評估結果，而且需要在你的驗證計畫裡說明理由。
blocks.en: But this reduction must be based on the assessment results, and the rationale must be explained in your validation plan.

blocks.zh: 10.3–10.4 Types of Assessment & The Assessment Process 10.3–10.4 評估類型與評估程序
blocks.en: 10.3–10.4 Types of Assessment & The Assessment Process

blocks.zh: 中文解說：三種評估方式的選擇邏輯
blocks.en: Commentary: Logic for Choosing Among the Three Assessment Methods

blocks.zh: 核心原則：合約簽前要完成評估
blocks.en: Core Principle: Complete the Assessment Before the Contract

blocks.zh: GAMP 明確說："assessment should be completed before any contract is finalized"。
blocks.en: GAMP states clearly: "assessment should be completed before any contract is finalized".

blocks.zh: 實際上很多公司是先簽合約、系統都上線了才做供應商評估，這在監管角度是錯誤的。評估的目的是幫助你做出採購決策，而不是事後補文件。
blocks.en: In practice, many companies sign the contract first and only perform the supplier assessment after the system has gone live, which is wrong from a regulatory standpoint. The purpose of assessment is to help you make the purchasing decision, not to backfill documents afterwards.

blocks.zh: 如果已經採用了沒評估的供應商，處理方式是做「retrospective assessment」，並在驗證計畫中說明為什麼當時沒有事先評估。
blocks.en: If you have already adopted a supplier that was not assessed, the remedy is to perform a "retrospective assessment" and explain in the validation plan why no assessment was done beforehand.

blocks.zh: Basic Assessment 的常見誤用
blocks.en: Common Misuse of the Basic Assessment

blocks.zh: Basic Assessment 只適用於「商品化軟體」（commodity software），例如 Microsoft Excel、Windows OS。
blocks.en: The Basic Assessment is suitable only for commodity software, such as Microsoft Excel or the Windows OS.

blocks.zh: 常見的錯誤是把 Postal Audit 簡化成 Basic Assessment，理由是「這個軟體很有名」或「業界都在用」。知名度不等於 GxP 品質，Oracle EBS 或 SAP 也需要做正式的評估。
blocks.en: A common error is to downgrade a Postal Audit to a Basic Assessment on the grounds that "this software is well known" or "everyone in the industry uses it". Being well known does not equal GxP quality; Oracle EBS or SAP also need a formal assessment.

blocks.zh: 供應商稽查排程管理建議
blocks.en: Recommendations for Managing the Supplier Audit Schedule

blocks.zh: 建議維護一份「Supplier Audit Schedule」，包含：
blocks.en: We recommend maintaining a "Supplier Audit Schedule" that includes:

blocks.zh: 供應商名稱與產品/服務
blocks.en: Supplier name and product/service

blocks.zh: 上次評估日期與方式
blocks.en: Date and method of the last assessment

blocks.zh: 評估結果（接受/條件接受/拒絕）
blocks.en: Assessment result (accepted / conditionally accepted / rejected)

blocks.zh: 未完結的矯正行動
blocks.en: Open corrective actions

blocks.zh: 下次評估預定日期與方式
blocks.en: Planned date and method of the next assessment

blocks.zh: 負責的稽查員
blocks.en: Responsible auditor

blocks.zh: 這份清冊在稽查中非常有用，可以快速展示你對所有供應商的掌握狀況。
blocks.en: This list is very useful in an inspection, because it lets you quickly demonstrate that you have control over all your suppliers.

blocks.zh: 10.4.3 Postal/Email Audits 10.4.3 郵件 / 電子郵件稽核
blocks.en: 10.4.3 Postal/Email Audits

blocks.zh: 中文解說：Postal Audit 的實務要點
blocks.en: Commentary: Practical Points on Postal Audits

blocks.zh: Postal Audit 的多重用途
blocks.en: The Many Uses of a Postal Audit

blocks.zh: Postal Audit 很靈活，可以扮演不同角色：
blocks.en: A postal audit is flexible and can play different roles:

blocks.zh: 採購前篩選：在評估 3 家 LIMS 廠商時，先發 postal audit 問卷，根據回答縮小到 1-2 家再做 on-site
blocks.en: Pre-purchase screening: when evaluating 3 LIMS vendors, send the postal audit questionnaire first and narrow the field to 1-2 vendors based on the responses before conducting an on-site audit

blocks.zh: 現有供應商的定期複評：合作多年的廠商，每 2-3 年的再評估可以用 postal audit 代替昂貴的現場稽查
blocks.en: Periodic re-evaluation of existing suppliers: for vendors you have worked with for years, a postal audit can replace an expensive on-site audit for the re-evaluation every 2-3 years

blocks.zh: 矯正行動追蹤：現場稽查後有 CAPA，可以用 postal audit 確認完成情況
blocks.en: Corrective action follow-up: if an on-site audit resulted in CAPAs, a postal audit can be used to confirm completion

blocks.zh: Postal Audit 最大的陷阱：沒有證據支持
blocks.en: The Biggest Pitfall of Postal Audits: No Supporting Evidence

blocks.zh: 很多供應商會寫漂亮的答案，但如果沒有附上實際的文件證據（actual artifacts），這份問卷的價值幾乎是零。
blocks.en: Many suppliers write polished answers, but if no actual documentary evidence (actual artifacts) is attached, the value of the questionnaire is close to zero.

blocks.zh: 要求供應商提供：
blocks.en: Ask the supplier to provide:

blocks.zh: 實際的測試計畫範例（不是模板，是真實執行過的）
blocks.en: Examples of actual test plans (not templates, but ones that were really executed)

blocks.zh: 變更控制記錄的示例
blocks.en: Examples of change control records

blocks.zh: 軟體品質計畫的現行版本
blocks.en: The current version of the software quality plan

blocks.zh: 客戶問題/缺陷記錄（可匿名化）的統計數據
blocks.en: Statistics from customer issue/defect records (may be anonymized)

blocks.zh: 版本特定性的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of Version Specificity

blocks.zh: GAMP 特別提醒：軟體評估是「版本特定」的。
blocks.en: GAMP specifically reminds us that software assessment is "version-specific".

blocks.zh: 你對 LIMS v5.2 做的評估，不能自動套用到 v6.0。主版本升級時需要重新評估（至少更新評估報告，說明升級的影響範圍）。
blocks.en: An assessment you performed on LIMS v5.2 cannot automatically be applied to v6.0. A major version upgrade requires re-assessment (at minimum, an updated assessment report explaining the scope of impact of the upgrade).

blocks.zh: 這對 SaaS 供應商特別重要——他們可能每季更新，你需要在合約中要求供應商通知重大版本變更，並提供更新的驗證支持文件。
blocks.en: This is especially important for SaaS suppliers, who may release updates every quarter; you should require in the contract that the supplier notifies you of major version changes and provides updated validation support documents.

blocks.zh: Postal Audit 升級到 On-site 的觸發點
blocks.en: Triggers for Escalating a Postal Audit to On-Site

blocks.zh: 什麼情況下應該把 postal audit 升級為 on-site？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances should a postal audit be escalated to an on-site audit?

blocks.zh: 供應商對關鍵問題的答案含糊不清
blocks.en: The supplier's answers to critical questions are vague

blocks.zh: 提供的文件明顯不完整或互相矛盾
blocks.en: The documents provided are clearly incomplete or contradictory

blocks.zh: 供應商拒絕提供支持文件
blocks.en: The supplier refuses to provide supporting documents

blocks.zh: 市場上有負面反饋（客訴、FDA warning letter 記錄）
blocks.en: There is negative feedback in the market (complaints, FDA warning letter records)

blocks.zh: 系統影響評估升級（高風險系統）
blocks.en: The system impact assessment is raised (high-risk system)

blocks.zh: GAMP 說這種升級是完全合理的，最終的 on-site 報告要說明為何從 postal 改為 on-site。
blocks.en: GAMP says such an escalation is entirely reasonable, and the final on-site report should explain why the approach changed from postal to on-site.

blocks.zh: 10.4.4–10.4.8 On-Site/Virtual Online Audits 10.4.4–10.4.8 現場 / 虛擬線上稽核
blocks.en: 10.4.4–10.4.8 On-Site/Virtual Online Audits

blocks.zh: 中文解說：現場稽查的策略與技巧
blocks.en: Commentary: Strategy and Techniques for On-Site Audits

blocks.zh: "Show Me" 原則
blocks.en: The "Show Me" Principle

blocks.zh: GAMP 明確說稽查員應採用「show me」方式——不接受口頭解釋，要看實際的文件和記錄。
blocks.en: GAMP states clearly that auditors should take a "show me" approach: verbal explanations are not accepted; you need to see the actual documents and records.

blocks.zh: 稽查中常見的問答：
blocks.en: Typical exchanges during an audit:

blocks.zh: 「你們有做 code review 嗎？」→「有」→「請給我看最近三個 sprint 的 code review 記錄」
blocks.en: "Do you perform code reviews?" → "Yes" → "Please show me the code review records for the last three sprints"

blocks.zh: 「你們有缺陷追蹤嗎？」→「有，用 Jira」→「請讓我看一個已解決的 critical bug 的完整追蹤記錄」
blocks.en: "Do you track defects?" → "Yes, in Jira" → "Please show me the complete tracking record of one resolved critical bug"

blocks.zh: 沒有文件支持的口頭聲明，在稽查記錄中的價值為零。
blocks.en: A verbal claim without supporting documents has zero value in the audit record.

blocks.zh: 供應商接受決策的五個層次
blocks.en: Five Levels of Supplier Acceptance Decision

blocks.zh: GAMP 給了五種接受結果，這是一個梯度決策：
blocks.en: GAMP gives five possible acceptance outcomes, forming a graduated decision scale:

blocks.zh: 無條件接受：最理想，供應商各方面都達標
blocks.en: Unconditional acceptance: the ideal outcome; the supplier meets expectations in all respects

blocks.zh: 部分/版本特定接受：某些功能或版本合格，其他不合格
blocks.en: Partial / version-specific acceptance: certain functions or versions are acceptable, others are not

blocks.zh: 條件接受 + CAPA：有問題但可修復，設定截止日期
blocks.en: Conditional acceptance + CAPA: there are problems but they can be fixed, with a deadline set

blocks.zh: 接受 + 加強自有測試：供應商有缺口，但你用自己的測試彌補（成本最高）
blocks.en: Acceptance + increased in-house testing: the supplier has gaps, but you compensate with your own testing (highest cost)

blocks.zh: 拒絕：問題太嚴重，不能使用
blocks.en: Rejection: the problems are too serious for the system to be used

blocks.zh: 第四個選項（加強自有測試）是最常被低估的：當你選擇這個選項，你就是在用自己的驗證資源補供應商的不足。必須在驗證計畫中明確說明，並估算額外的測試工作量。
blocks.en: The fourth option (increased in-house testing) is the most commonly underestimated: when you choose it, you are using your own validation resources to make up for the supplier's shortcomings. It must be stated explicitly in the validation plan, with the additional testing effort estimated.

blocks.zh: 紅旗警訊：什麼時候需要加強自有測試？
blocks.en: Red Flags: When Is Increased In-House Testing Needed?

blocks.zh: 以下任何一個都是需要增加自有測試量的紅旗：
blocks.en: Any of the following is a red flag indicating that the amount of in-house testing should be increased:

blocks.zh: 供應商沒有正式的 SDLC 文件
blocks.en: The supplier has no formal SDLC documentation

blocks.zh: 測試記錄不完整或找不到
blocks.en: Test records are incomplete or cannot be found

blocks.zh: 沒有從需求到測試的可追蹤性
blocks.en: There is no traceability from requirements to tests

blocks.zh: QA 部門對開發/測試過程的介入程度很低
blocks.en: QA involvement in the development/testing process is very low

blocks.zh: 版本歷史顯示高比率的「緊急修補」(hotfix)
blocks.en: Version history shows a high rate of "emergency patches" (hotfixes)

blocks.zh: 供應商拒絕展示實際的開發過程記錄
blocks.en: The supplier refuses to show actual development process records

blocks.zh: 有其他客戶的 regulatory 問題記錄
blocks.en: There are records of regulatory problems with other customers

blocks.zh: 再評估的觸發條件
blocks.en: Triggers for Re-Evaluation

blocks.zh: 特別注意：「從 on-premise 轉為 cloud」是第二版新增的再評估觸發條件。
blocks.en: Note in particular: "moving from on-premise to cloud" is a new re-evaluation trigger in the second edition.

blocks.zh: 這對現在的 CDMO 很實際——很多 LIMS、DMS 廠商正在把產品從安裝版改為 SaaS。這種模式轉變從根本上改變了供應商的 IT 基礎架構、安全控制和資料主權，需要重新做完整的評估，不能用舊的評估報告。
blocks.en: This is very relevant for CDMOs today, as many LIMS and DMS vendors are converting their products from installed software to SaaS. This change of model fundamentally alters the supplier's IT infrastructure, security controls and data sovereignty, and requires a complete new assessment; the old assessment report cannot be used.

blocks.zh: 矯正行動跟進的實務建議
blocks.en: Practical Advice on Corrective Action Follow-Up

blocks.zh: GAMP 明確說：供應商的「確認信」不夠，你需要看到實際的文件證據。
blocks.en: GAMP states clearly: a "confirmation letter" from the supplier is not enough; you need to see actual documentary evidence.

blocks.zh: 建議的 CAPA 跟進清單：
blocks.en: Suggested CAPA follow-up checklist:

blocks.zh: 缺少 SDLC 文件 → 要求提供新制定的程序文件 + 已按新程序執行的示例
blocks.en: Missing SDLC documentation → request the newly established procedure plus examples executed under the new procedure

blocks.zh: 測試記錄不完整 → 要求提供修正後的測試報告模板 + 至少一個版本的完整測試記錄
blocks.en: Incomplete test records → request the corrected test report template plus the complete test records for at least one version

blocks.zh: 沒有可追蹤性矩陣 → 要求提供新版本的 RTM (Requirements Traceability Matrix)
blocks.en: No traceability matrix → request an RTM (Requirements Traceability Matrix) for the new version

blocks.zh: 設定明確的截止日期，並在截止後跟進。如果 CAPA 沒有完成，升級到 follow-up on-site audit 或重新考慮供應商資格。
blocks.en: Set clear deadlines and follow up after they pass. If a CAPA is not completed, escalate to a follow-up on-site audit or reconsider the supplier's qualification.

blocks.zh: 10.5–10.10 Joint Audits, Shared Reports, Corporate Audits & Certification 10.5–10.10 聯合稽核、共享報告、企業稽核與認證
blocks.en: 10.5–10.10 Joint Audits, Shared Reports, Corporate Audits & Certification

blocks.zh: 中文解說：聯合稽查、企業稽查與認證
blocks.en: Commentary: Joint Audits, Corporate Audits and Certification

blocks.zh: 聯合稽查的現實意義
blocks.en: The Practical Significance of Joint Audits

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，聯合稽查特別有意義：
blocks.en: Joint audits are particularly meaningful for CDMOs:

blocks.zh: 你的 LIMS 供應商可能同時服務幾十家製藥公司。如果每家都去現場稽查，供應商每年要接待幾十次稽查，這是巨大的負擔，也不可持續。
blocks.en: Your LIMS supplier may serve dozens of pharmaceutical companies at the same time. If each of them audits on site, the supplier has to host dozens of audits a year, which is a huge burden and unsustainable.

blocks.zh: 業界聯合稽查的模式（如 ISPE 的共享稽查計畫）讓幾家公司共享稽查資源，既降低成本，又讓稽查更深入（多方視角）。
blocks.en: Industry joint audit models (such as ISPE's shared audit program) let several companies share audit resources, which both lowers cost and makes audits more in-depth (multiple perspectives).

blocks.zh: 集中稽查資料庫的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of a Central Audit Database

blocks.zh: 大型 CDMO 可能有多個部門在稽查同一個供應商：QA 做 GxP 稽查，IT 做資安稽查，採購做商業稽查。
blocks.en: A large CDMO may have several departments auditing the same supplier: QA performs the GxP audit, IT performs the information security audit, and Procurement performs the commercial audit.

blocks.zh: 沒有集中資料庫的後果：
blocks.en: Consequences of having no central database:

blocks.zh: 同一供應商被稽查 3 次，浪費資源
blocks.en: The same supplier is audited 3 times, wasting resources

blocks.zh: 不同部門的結論可能矛盾
blocks.en: Conclusions from different departments may contradict each other

blocks.zh: 稽查發現的問題在各部門之間沒有共享
blocks.en: Audit findings are not shared between departments

blocks.zh: 建議建立一個簡單的 Supplier Qualification Master List，由 QA 集中管理，所有部門的稽查記錄都集中存放。
blocks.en: We recommend setting up a simple Supplier Qualification Master List, managed centrally by QA, in which the audit records of all departments are stored.

blocks.zh: 認證 vs 供應商評估：不能替代，但可以減少工作量
blocks.en: Certification vs Supplier Assessment: Not a Replacement, but It Can Reduce the Workload

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 認證不等於 GxP 合規，但它是個加分項。邏輯是：
blocks.en: ISO 9001 certification does not equal GxP compliance, but it is a plus. The logic is:

blocks.zh: 有 ISO 9001 認證 → 基本 QMS 框架存在 → 減少稽查對「有沒有 QMS」的基礎確認時間，讓你把稽查時間集中在 GxP 特定要求
blocks.en: ISO 9001 certified → a basic QMS framework exists → less audit time spent confirming the basics of "is there a QMS", so you can focus audit time on GxP-specific requirements

blocks.zh: 有 SOC 2+ Type II 報告 → IT 安全控制有第三方驗證 → 對 SaaS 供應商特別重要
blocks.en: SOC 2+ Type II report → IT security controls are third-party verified → especially important for SaaS suppliers

blocks.zh: 關鍵是確認認證的「範圍」(scope) 是否涵蓋你使用的產品和服務，過期的認證或範圍不符的認證沒有價值。
blocks.en: The key is to confirm whether the certification scope covers the products and services you use; an expired certification or one with a mismatched scope has no value.

blocks.zh: SaaS 供應商的評估策略（CDMO 場景）
blocks.en: Assessment Strategy for SaaS Suppliers (CDMO Scenario)

blocks.zh: 對於 SaaS LIMS 或 QMS（如 Veeva Vault、Sparta Trackwise Digital）：
blocks.en: For SaaS LIMS or QMS (such as Veeva Vault or Sparta Trackwise Digital):

blocks.zh: 索取 SOC 2 Type II 報告：確認控制設計和運作有效性（最近 12 個月）
blocks.en: Request the SOC 2 Type II report: confirm the design and operating effectiveness of controls (most recent 12 months)

blocks.zh: 確認 ISO 27001 認證：確認範圍涵蓋你使用的服務
blocks.en: Confirm ISO 27001 certification: confirm the scope covers the services you use

blocks.zh: 虛擬稽查重點：資料主權（你的資料存在哪個地理位置）、備份和 DR 程序、存取控制架構、重大事故通知程序
blocks.en: Virtual audit focus areas: data sovereignty (in which geographic location your data is stored), backup and DR procedures, access control architecture, major incident notification procedures

blocks.zh: 合約中明確的要求：版本升級通知提前 X 天、資安事故通知時限、稽查配合義務
blocks.en: Explicit contract requirements: advance notice of X days for version upgrades, time limit for notification of security incidents, obligation to cooperate with audits

blocks.zh: 這套流程比傳統的現場稽查更適合 SaaS 供應商的特性，也符合 GAMP 5 第二版的精神。
blocks.en: This approach suits the characteristics of SaaS suppliers better than a traditional on-site audit, and is also consistent with the spirit of GAMP 5 Second Edition.

blocks.zh: Section Summary 章節總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: CDMO 整合應用重點
blocks.en: Key Points for Integrated Application in a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對於無菌製造 CDMO，M1 + M2 的最大價值在於建立一套「分層、差異化的 CSV 管理體系」：LIMS/MES 等核心系統做完整的 CSV + 供應商稽查；設備 PLC 整合進設備確效；SaaS 工具以認證評估為主；所有決策都記錄在各系統的驗證計畫中，集中在 VMP（或 CSV Inventory）中呈現全廠全貌。這套體系既符合監管要求，又在資源有限的 CDMO 環境中可持續運作。
blocks.en: For a sterile manufacturing CDMO, the greatest value of M1 + M2 lies in establishing a "tiered, differentiated CSV management system": core systems such as LIMS/MES receive full CSV plus supplier audits; equipment PLCs are integrated into equipment qualification; SaaS tools are assessed mainly through certifications; and all decisions are recorded in each system's validation plan, with the whole-site picture presented in the VMP (or CSV inventory). This system both meets regulatory requirements and remains sustainable in a resource-constrained CDMO environment.
